kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

lines.say: Good morning. Got a shift you don't feel ready for? This is for you.
lines.small: Got a shift you don't feel ready for? This is for you.

lines.say: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me. Philippians four, verse thirteen.
lines.big: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

lines.say: Paul wrote that from a jail cell. The strength showed up after he moved.
lines.big: Paul wrote that from a jail cell. The strength showed up after he moved.

lines.say: Lord, I can't carry today on my own. Strengthen me through it. In Jesus' name, amen.
Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.
